items.title: Amid Higher Gas And Grocery Prices, GTA 6 Is A "Bargain" At $80, Take-Two CEO Says
items.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told CNBC that $80 is a bargain for GTA 6 given its hours of gameplay, even with inflation squeezing consumers.

items.title: New GTA 6 trailer showcases PS5-exclusive DualSense features
items.summary: A new PlayStation-promoted trailer shows GTA 6's haptic feedback for recoil and weightlifting, plus police radio chatter through the controller speaker.

items.title: GTA 6 Trailer 4 Officially Released
items.summary: Rockstar released a short PS5-captured trailer with new Vice City scenes to mark the start of pre-loading.

items.title: GTA 6 won't run at 60fps even on PS5 Pro, but Sony's console does have an exclusive: ray-traced shadows and PSSR
items.summary: A Rockstar blog post confirmed a 30fps target on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with PS5 Pro getting PSSR and ray-traced shadows and Xbox getting cloud play.

items.title: GTA 6 Has Dethroned Cyberpunk 2077 To Set An Incredible New Pre-Order Record
items.summary: Sensor Tower data estimates 9.69 million pre-orders, about 75% of them on PS5, which would beat Cyberpunk 2077's previous record of 8 million.

items.title: GTA 6 is officially the "most pre-ordered game" in PlayStation and Xbox store history, Sony and Microsoft confirm
items.summary: Sony and Microsoft both confirmed GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered title in their stores' histories, and Sensor Tower estimates about 9.69 million pre-orders.

items.title: GTA 6 Won't Have Any Last Minute Delays, as It's Officially Gone Gold
items.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick confirmed on the earnings call that GTA 6 has gone gold, and told IGN there will be no further delays before the November 19 launch.

items.title: GTA 7 Won't Take as Long as GTA 6, Says Take-Two CEO
items.summary: Zelnick says future Grand Theft Auto projects should develop with greater "velocity" thanks to the groundwork laid during GTA 6's development.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 will be playable on Xbox Cloud Gaming — but there are a few catches
items.summary: Rockstar confirmed day-one Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One using Series S graphics settings, with no PC or mobile streaming.

items.title: A $3000 Varsity Jacket And Everything Else In The GTA 6 Selfridges Collection
items.summary: The 62-item GTA 6 x Selfridges collection is available online, though the $3,025 varsity jacket appears to have already sold out.
